description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans clusters using multiple grain directories with Redis as the storage backend. It defines a test class `RedisMultipleGrainDirectoriesTests` that configures a test cluster with Redis grain directory support and includes a nested `SiloConfigurator` class to set up Redis-specific options.

classes.name: RedisMultipleGrainDirectoriesTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing Orleans clusters with multiple Redis grain directories. Configures the test cluster and includes precondition checks for Redis.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow
methods.description: Checks if Redis is available and throws an exception if not.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Sets up the test cluster with Redis grain directory configurations, including a custom silo configurator.
